observations: Photo shows a wall-mounted/standing TV console unit with open shelves on the left and a large central TV screen area.
The TV screen appears black/off; no clear brand/model text is visible on the screen bezel.
There are two long horizontal compartments/shelves on the right side of the console.
The unit looks like dark wood/woodgrain with lighter panels; overall condition appears used but intact in the photo.

claims.claim: Relocating. come carry this center table and TV console
claims.evidence: Only one photo is provided and it mainly shows a TV console; a separate center table is not clearly shown.
The photo does not show the price; price must come from the later list.
No comparable pricing or condition details are shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Whether a separate center table is included (photo may only show the TV console).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the center table fully (top + legs) and confirm it is included in the same package.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV console only (center table not included).

risks.risk: Whether the TV itself is included and working (screen is off/black; no power-on proof).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering on the TV and showing a channel/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only, or as TV not confirmed working (worst case: not working/unknown).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one angle (scratches, water damage, loose hinges/shelves).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of edges/corners, shelf joints, and any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming normal wear with possible minor damage (no premium).

risks.risk: Exact dimensions/fit (console size affects buyer value in Oyo).
risks.proof: Ask for measurements: width, height, depth (and TV size if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price at a generic used console value without size premium.

proof_requests: Confirm if the item includes ONLY the TV console or also a separate center table; send a full photo of the center table if included.
If a TV is included: send a short video showing the TV turning on and displaying clearly.
Send close-up photos of corners/edges and shelf joints to confirm condition.
Send measurements (W×H×D) of the console and TV size (if included).
response.reason: From the photo, I can see a TV console, but I cannot verify that a separate center table is included or that any TV (if included) is working. Those points materially change the price.
